subject: POC benchmarking: scheduling hands-on load test & test-harness review
messages:
From: Jessica Lee <jessica.lee@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Barnes <evan.barnes@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC benchmarking — kickoff & load testing windows?

Hi Rishi / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is keen to move from an exploratory demo to a hands-on POC. Our goals for the session are:

- Validate throughput at 50 QPS sustained (95th pct token latency target < 120ms)
- Walk through prompt routing / prompt-review heuristics and prefix caching behavior
- Run a short end-to-end run with our test harness (attached: sample harness outline)

Questions / asks: can we schedule a 2-hour working session next week for the full run + tuning? We have internal infra folks and a procurement observer joining. Preferable windows (PST):

- Tue 2026-06-30 09:00–11:00
- Wed 2026-07-01 13:00–15:00

If those don't work, suggest alternatives. Also please confirm who from Redwood will lead the load-test setup and whether you need us to provide additional test data or keys.

Thanks,
Jessica
Jessica Lee
Technical Program Manager — Platform
Acme Analytics
[Attachment: acme-harness-outline.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Lee <jessica.lee@acmeanalytics.com>, Evan Barnes <evan.barnes@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC benchmarking — kickoff & load testing windows?

Hi Jessica — great to hear the team is ready. Monica will lead the hands-on session and Diego will handle infra/load harness configuration. Proposed agenda (attached):

1) Quick alignment (15m) — success criteria, SLOs, data locality
2) Prompt review & routing rules (30m) — prefix caching discussion
3) Test harness setup (30m) — coordinate keys, test client, ramp plan
4) Controlled load run (35m) — 50 QPS target, watch KV cache behavior

We can do Tue 09:00–11:00 PST on 2026-06-30. If that works for you we'll send a calendar invite.

Before the session: please share a 5–10 minute sample trace and a small representative workload (we saw the outline — thanks). Diego: can you confirm if we need to pre-stage any model variants or specific quantization settings?

Attachments: redwood-poc-agenda-v1.docx, benchmark-harness-specs.pdf

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[mobile: +1-415-555-0123]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-28T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC benchmarking — kickoff & load testing windows?

On 2026-06-28 11:05, Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> We can do Tue 09:00–11:00 PST on 2026-06-30. If that works for you we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — quick technical note: to avoid noisy starts I'd like to run a short 15–20 minute ramp at 10 QPS first (sanity run) before the full 50 QPS surge. That helps us validate prefix/KV cache hit rates and ensures no node OOMs with your payloads.

Diego — do we need the customer to provide any pre-signed URLs for large test payloads or should we pull a small sample (they referenced test-data-samples.tar.gz in their outline)?

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: small-ramp-plan.txt]
